symptom: A QA-local Director repair emitted native edit_file calls but produced no physical effect; the bootstrap follow-up failed before tool execution with deo_inventory_seal_failed:inventory_seal_conflict:result_not_ok,unexpected_code:inventory_seal_conflict,projection_missing.
root_cause: TurnDecisionDecoder derives every tool batch in one turn as <turn_id>_batch. After a stale edit seals the first immutable DEO inventory, the refreshed bootstrap follow-up emits a different edit under the same parent batch identity. DEO correctly rejects the changed inventory as drift.

runtime_evidence.initial_error: single_batch_contract_violation: write tool batch produced no effects and requires a new invocation within the authorized target scope; error_types=stale_edit
runtime_evidence.provider_latency_observation: The first provider response was HTTP 200 in approximately 5.7 seconds; the dominant delay was local context/runtime processing.

fix.mechanism: Rebind each mutation retry and bootstrap follow-up to a deterministic phase-and-ordinal batch id. Exact replay retains its id; a new provider decision receives a distinct immutable inventory.
fix.guardrail: DEO inventory sealing remains fail-closed and unchanged.

verification.facade_a: 60 passed as part of combined run

requirements: same-run QA-local retry does not call PM or Chief Engineer
stale edit bootstrap follow-up seals a distinct inventory
only the failed go test verifier reruns
ProjectArtifactReceiptV1 and TaskRuntime settlement remain authoritative
